function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the full contents of a text file, relative to the working directory.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create a file or overwrite it entirely with new content. Use for new files or full rewrites.

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact, unique occurrence of `search` with `replace` in an existing file. Prefer this over write_file for small changes. Include enough surrounding context in `search` that it matches only once.

search.description: Exact existing text to find (must match exactly once)

function.name: list_files
function.description: List files and folders at a path, relative to the working directory.

function.name: search_files
function.description: Search file contents for a plain text pattern across the working directory. Use this before read_file to locate where something is, instead of guessing paths.

path.description: Relative directory to search within, default '.'

function.name: run_command
function.description: Run a shell command in the working directory and wait for it to finish. Do not use this to start long-running/background processes.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web for current information — news, docs, prices, versions, anything that could have changed recently or that you're not sure about. Returns a grounded answer with source citations. Uses Gemini's Google Search grounding under the hood.
